analysis:
The changes in docs/developer/test.md are documentation-only. The patch excerpt (hunks around head lines 770-788) updates the Add-On Hold test guidance. It adds load-fence and managed Super cases to the --filter selector, notes that those cases load synthetic tiny weights through MLX and need the staged test metallib, and adds a test for a FIFO record being refused without blocking in the owner-only record store. The excerpt is truncated, and the head text supplied starts at line 1 but only shows the header and early sections (up to about line 474), so the Add-On Hold section at head lines 770+ was not directly visible in the supplied head_text. The base text shows lines 947-1358 and does not include the changed region. I therefore cannot verify the exact wording beyond the patch excerpt.

Security relevance: this touches TB-012/A-018/T-059 (local add-on hold socket, same-UID peer policy) only through test descriptions. No runtime code, secrets or configuration changed. The documented tests (a FIFO record refused without blocking, load fence retiring the Super slot while keeping its preload plan) describe hardening against local DoS, which is consistent with T-059. No regression, new attack surface or threat-model invalidation is identified. Remaining unverified items are the production sources behind these tests, such as the add-on hold store and the load fence. They are not in this batch and should be reviewed if changed in the same PR. needs_deeper_review is set to false because this unit is documentation only.
